cuts.ofreeRecent: a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her left side; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — brings a cup to her lips; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — standing; a walled garden with a lotus pond — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — examines a small object on the table through a magnifying glass; her crew cabin aboard a starship — tilts a cup; her living room with a deep sofa — sitting on the ground; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — lying on her front; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing
